name: IE-NeRF
aliases: Image-dependent NeRF with transient mask inpainting
definition: A NeRF variant that enhances novel view synthesis in uncontrolled environments by separating static scene rendering from transient occlusions using an inpainting module, rather than using dual NeRFs or prior-assisted segmentation.
summary: IE-NeRF is a neural radiance field method that separates static scene rendering from transient occlusions using image-dependent feature encodings and a pre-trained inpainting module for supervision.
